Revv Amplification browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by type simulation amp simulation browse by enclosure pedal Revv Amplification G3 - Purple Channel Overdrive Published on January 4, 2019 Revv Amplification amp simulation overdrive pedal 2024 Anniversary Edition 2024 Anniversary 2024 Anniversary Edition 2024 Anniversary black sparkle black sparkle v2 v2 v2 Canadian edition v2 Canadian edition Information The Revv Amplification G3 Purple Channel Overdrive is an all-analog high-gain distortion and preamp pedal based on the signature Purple Channel of Revv's Generator 120 amplifier series. Designed as an "amp-in-a-box" recreation of the original channel, the G3 delivers razor-tight low end, focused midrange, and clear, articulate high-gain saturation with a stringy attack that preserves note definition even under extreme gain or downtuned playing. Originally introduced in 2018, the G3 established a benchmark for modern high-gain pedals by translating Revv's flagship amplifier tone into a compact, pedalboard-friendly format. The pedal is engineered to function as a preamp platform rather than a conventional distortion box. It can be run in front of a clean amplifier, into an effects loop return or power amp, or integrated with modelers, impulse responses, and hybrid analog-digital rigs. Smart filtering shapes the frequency response to keep lows tight and highs present, avoiding mud or harshness while maintaining mix-ready clarity. The result is a distortion character that remains defined across a wide gain range, from mid-gain crunch to saturated modern metal lead tones. A powerful 3-band EQ provides extensive tone shaping, allowing the G3 to adapt to various guitars, pickup types, and amplification setups. The pedal's three-position Aggression toggle significantly alters saturation, compression, and low-end response. With the switch in the Off position, the tone is comparatively dry and stringy, offering touch-sensitive mid-gain textures. The Blue mode increases saturation and is often considered a balanced high-gain setting. Red mode delivers the highest gain and compression, producing liquid sustain suited for lead work and thick rhythm tones.
